Edit this profile; active_scenario in settings selects the live version.

Alex, 17, has been on the CAMHS inpatient ward for six days for support with depression and anxiety. This afternoon they stopped joining activities, declined lunch and asked to stay in their room. A colleague reports that Alex mentioned tummy pain. Alex can communicate clearly but is worried about not being taken seriously.
Edit this profile; active_scenario in settings selects the live version.

Depression and anxiety; previous constipation during admission. No recorded abdominal surgery and no known drug allergies. Check the medication chart rather than assuming medicines or doses. Speak directly to Alex, explain confidentiality and its safety limits, seek their agreement, and ask how they would like a parent, carer or trusted adult involved. Do not dismiss new physical symptoms as anxiety.
